svg.title: 04 Featured: Dubai property prices. 109,706 cleaned sales across 147 communities. 7.8% model error against a 10.9% baseline. 78% of later sales inside the 80% interval.
svg.text: What flats and villas sell for per square metre in each
Dubai community, from every 2026 sale registered with the
Dubai Land Department. A model scored only on months it
never saw, and a static explorer anyone can use.
